create_aria_image_processor: create an AriaImageProcessorPil instance with custom max_image_size, min_image_size, and split_resolutions parameters
build_image_patches: build image patches from a high-resolution image using get_image_patches with grid_pinpoints and patch_size
resize_image_for_patching: resize an image to a target resolution while maintaining aspect ratio using _resize_for_patching
pad_image_for_patching: pad an image to a target resolution with centered padding using _pad_for_patching
preprocess_images: preprocess a batch of images with resizing, padding, normalization, and optional patch splitting
